Source: AMD FidelityFX SDK 1.1.4 (https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK, tag `v1.1.4`, commit `c6efa6bf7f2027b3ec94f28578bb5965eabb9e55`), FSR 3.1.4's upscaler GLSL passes (`sdk/src/backends/vk/shaders/fsr3upscaler`, with the GPU headers in `sdk/include/FidelityFX/gpu`), unmodified, compiled to SPIR-V 1.3 with glslang 16.6.0: reversed depth, HDR colour, render-size motion vectors, no half precision, the SPD passes with and without wave operations, the accumulate pass with and without sharpening. License in LICENSE.txt (MIT; the SDK's own file at that commit, verbatim).
Use: the SPIR-V is committed in `dm/gfx/vk_android/fsr3/*.h`; `dm/gfx/vk_android/vka_fsr3.c` runs the passes in place of an NVN2 game's DLSS evaluation (`DM_VK_DLSS=4`, the Upscaler row's FSR 3.1). The passes, internal images and constants follow the SDK's `ffx_fsr3upscaler.cpp`.
Rebuild: `python3 dm/tools/fsr3_shaders.py` fetches the pinned SDK commit (only the two folders above) and regenerates the headers; `--check` compares instead of writing (all eleven match byte for byte with glslang 16.6.0). The defines and variants are listed in the script.
